substitutions.regex: Families go by prefix: `claude-\*`, and `grok-\*` with `cursor-grok-\*` and `composer-\*`\. A refused `composer-\*` entry runs on `[^`]+`\.

substitutions.literal: The judge is never from the parent's family, as Phase A step 3 defines families. Try only the entries from another family, in pool order. An `auto` or `inherit-parent` entry is the parent model, so it never judges.

replacement.claude: The judge comes from the parent's own family, as Phase A step 3 defines families, and is a different model from the parent when the pool has one. Try the pool's entries in order and skip any outside the parent's family. An `auto` or `inherit-parent` entry is the parent model, so it judges only when no other entry qualifies.
replacement.cursor: The judge runs on the pool's model, the same model as the runners, whatever the parent's model is. Do not look for a model from a second family. Try the pool's entries in order. An `auto` or `inherit-parent` entry is the parent model, so skip it.

substitutions.regex: With the default pool, a Claude parent gets `[^`]+`\. A parent from any other family gets `[^`]+` first\.

substitutions.literal: If no entry from another family runs, try the default pool's entries from another family the same way. If none of those runs, skip the judge, pick the base alone in Phase D, and say so. If you do not know the parent's model, try the pool's real slugs in pool order and say that the family check did not run.

replacement.claude: If no entry runs, run the judge on the parent model and say so. If you do not know the parent's model, try the pool's entries in order and say that the family check did not run.
replacement.cursor: If no entry runs, skip the judge, pick the base alone in Phase D, and say so.
